subject: Re: Proposal — pilot uplift voucher for Starnext (RDW-4832)
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-29T07:23:00-08:00
Subject: Proposal — pilot uplift voucher for Starnext (RDW-4832)

Hi team,

Quick context: Starnext (Amelia Ross) is in a tight EOQ evaluation window — they’ve been running a week-long pilot against our LLM hosting and have flagged token burn and latency as the final gating items to move to a paid Dedicated seat. They’ve asked for a small conversion sweetener to bridge procurement and the pilot metrics.

Proposal I’d like to offer (ask for sign-off):
- $6,000 promotional credit applied to first month of Dedicated usage
- 45-day extension of trial ingestion window to allow rule-based load tests
- Credit usage limited to inference tokens only (no training/exports)

Attached are the proposed credit terms and the pilot metrics snapshot we’ll share with the customer. My ask: approve so I can get DocuSign out today (EOQ push). If you prefer a different cap or expiry, say now — we need a quick decision to keep momentum.

Why this matters: Starnext is converting an ML ops team that could bring north of $80k ARR within 6 months if the Dedicated throughput meets their SLAs. This is a time-limited close opportunity.

Thanks,
Rachel
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
(rachel.kim@redwood.com)

Attachments: starnext-credit-terms-draft.pdf (PDF), starnext-eval-metrics.xlsx (Excel)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-29T09:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Proposal — pilot uplift voucher for Starnext (RDW-4832)

Rachel — thanks for the summary and the packet. Approve but suggest tightening the parameters:
- Cap at $5,500 instead of $6,000.
- Keep the 45-day extension but require credit redemption within the first 60 days of go-live.
- Require PO or signed DocuSign before applying credit.

Loop in Finance (Aditya) to confirm we can book this under "conversion incentive" and confirm revenue recognition boundaries. If Finance pushes back, revert to $3,500 voucher and standard 30-day extension.

Marissa
Director, Sales | Redwood Inference
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Amelia Ross <amelia.ross@starnext.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-29T11:10:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Proposal — pilot uplift voucher for Starnext (RDW-4832)

Hi Amelia — great work in the pilot, and thanks for sharing the evaluation notes yesterday. Per our call, we’d like to offer a promotional voucher so you can continue ingesting test load and validate Dedicated performance.

Approved terms (final):
- $5,500 credit applied to first Dedicated invoice
- 45-day trial extension from go-live date; credit must be redeemed within 60 days
- Applies to inference usage tokens only; standard enterprise T&Cs apply

Next step: Please sign the short DocuSign so we can attach credit to your account. Link here: https://app.docusign.com/abc123-starnext-voucher

I’ve attached the credit terms and the pilot metrics we used to size this. If you’d prefer a PO route, send the PO number and we’ll stage the credit pending procurement.

Thanks — happy to jump on a 15-minute call if you want to walk through redemption mechanics.

—
Rachel Kim
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
(rachel.kim@redwood.com)

Attachments: starnext-credit-terms-draft.pdf (PDF), starnext-eval-metrics.xlsx (Excel)
From: Amelia Ross <amelia.ross@starnext.ai>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-29T13:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Proposal — pilot uplift voucher for Starnext (RDW-4832)

Rachel — thanks for moving quickly. I reviewed the terms with procurement; we’ll sign the DocuSign today. PO will follow but procurement confirmed the credit approach is fine. PO: SNX-2026-1129 (will send official PDF after approvals).

One small ask: can we have engineering tag the Dedicated instance to our project id so we can track cost center usage? If yes, we’re green to proceed.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.
Amelia Ross
Head of ML Ops | Starnext
amelia.ross@starnext.ai
